name: proto-import-cycle-publishes-nothing
description: Every file of an import cycle fails, the one the compiler reaches first with the recursive-import error and the other with its import of a file that fails, and so does a file importing one of them: none of the three publishes a declaration, a schema-unparsed note names each, and a file outside the cycle is published. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
